verdict.rationale: Stagehand is itself a developer SDK. First-party docs say it works across TypeScript, Python, and Go, and the CrewAI integration explicitly wraps the "Stagehand Python SDK". A quickstart, API reference pages and AI coding-assistant rules support building against it. Community users report building scrapers with it hands-on. Missing for 10: detailed per-language SDK documentation (especially Go) and independent corroboration that the multi-language SDKs are at parity.
